blocks.text: In a 19-second clip posted to X, Gadi Eisenkot, a candidate for prime minister, stands with his arms outstretched and a huge smile on his face. In slow motion, he runs through a meadow toward a person who resembles his son, wearing a shirt with the words “Israeli Unity.” But Eisenkot sails past him and instead embraces Mansour Abbas, a prominent Arab politician who leads the Ra’am party, running in the elections. The video was posted on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s account. Opinion polls show Netanyahu and Eisenkot, who also happens to be a former chief of staff of the Israel Defense Forces, in a tight […]...
